notes.title: Devblog #03 - Medical Facilities and Healing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/7269c2b29cc59fa844397eb185f8a6f9d23f6189.png[/img]

Welcome to another Tax-Force devblog!

This time, we’re going to talk a bit about the medical facilities of Farset-13, what they can do for you and how you can improve them! 

[All images represent work in progress and are subject to change.]

[h1]The State of Farset-13 Medical Facilities[/h1]

At the start of your run, the healthcare in Farset-13 is the preserve of the privileged few. The cost of treatment, if you can even find an open clinic, is high. An unhealthy population means an unhealthy economy… so you should probably do something about it if you want to pay off that debt in time!

In Tax-Force, you don’t heal between missions. You have to pay to get patched up or head to your next mission injured. Of course, healing is only one thing you will want to pay for, so you’re going to have to think carefully about the balance of health versus strength.


[h1]Go-Go Life – The Health Shop[/h1]

Early on in the game, you will gain access to Go-Go Life, your local neighbourhood clinic, run by Doc Croc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/29e77f376cd4b1744dcefeb03c7cbcc16be47210.png[/img]

Doc Croc can offer you immediate treatment, as well as a number of handy pick-me-ups to help you during your missions. 

His stock and prices are directly tied to the current medical situation on Farset-13. With no investment, you’re going to see a range of sub-par products at outrageous prices.

If you invest in public healthcare, then you can look forward to falling healthcare costs for you and the citizens of Fortuna.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/3e3270efb136b80f3f3b3e17efac3d509670eab3.png[/img]

If you work with private healthcare providers, you might not see much of a reduction in costs, but you will certainly see an increase in quality, with rarer, more potent treatment options becoming available at no extra (personal) cost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/bf89e15e168cb2844ba92a5d23127ed65f254ba4.png[/img]

[h1]Health Items[/h1]

In addition to pre-mission patch-up jobs, Go-Go Life can offer you helpful items to make your job just a little bit safer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/c72d108863b64b18cc71a30561b8ed31802ca841.png[/img]

During a mission, you will have access to a small inventory, which can be stocked with up to three Go-Go Life items! 

Some of the most powerful of these items are the various types of health insurance that you can purchase. 

One example of health insurance with an added benefit is the Telekinetic Revive. Not only does it get you back on your feet, but it knocks all nearby enemies off theirs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/c761c66dd31a03a2c4715ee84eb33389262b78e4.gif[/img]

There are also some more traditional healing items that provide you with little health boosts and temporary buffs. The healing isn’t as good as going directly to Doc Croc, but it might be just what you need, when you need it.

Thanks for tuning in! We’re really excited for you to try the game and hope you’ve enjoyed this preview! Please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/outsidergames]Discord[/url] if you’d like to be part of our community. 

This is Tax-Force, signing off!

notes.title: Devblog #02 – City Economy
notes.content:
Howdy Tax Collectors!

This is our second Tax-Force devblog!

I’m sure you’re looking forward to busting some tax-dodging billionaires as soon as possible! This time we’re here to talk about what you get to do with all those hard-won taxes once you’ve busted some heads!


[h3]City Economy[/h3]

Farset-13 isn’t just in debt, every part of the city has been stripped to the bone by greedy profiteers. The few hospitals that are still open are barely running and cost a fortune to access, there’s barely any security keeping essential interplanetary shipments safe and you’ll be lucky to get to work with transport the way it is.

You can do something about it!

Every time you hunt down one of our tax-dodging billionaires, you’ll have a choice to make about whether you let them keep running business as usual (cutting you in on the profits), or taking back the resources they’ve horded over the years.

If you choose to take resources back, you can re-invest them into your public services, which, over time, will pay off the planet’s debt and maybe even improve some lives!


[h3]The City Changes[/h3]

If you do well in your missions, you’ll have more resources to invest in the three core aspects of your city. 

[b]Medical [/b] – When you buy more medical cards, the cost of your healthcare will go down, making it a little easier to survive the hunt for taxes. You’ll also find that this will improve the lives of the most vulnerable people in your city, changing their stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/caa33b6a9af36076fdff19d2bccaf38e1672afc6.png[/img]

[b]Security[/b] – As you improve the security of your city, you’ll find that your weapon shop stocks more items, as you secure more off-world trading routes. You might also find that there are people in your city who are happy to have their businesses protected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/a6d5f39983b91f7e0d15c47c90560873616a8831.png[/img]

[b]Infrastructure[/b] – As you improve the infrastructure of your city, the levels you fight your way through to reach your tax-dodging targets will change, giving you new ways to play. You’ll also find that your citizens have access to better homes and better transport, which they’ll no doubt thank you for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/3300d27732856060c28232bb2ed98c24bcbbc228.png[/img]

[h3]Card Collecting[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507630/f3c0f9cf09da52f7a84dbf5a4f0f1118cd987764.png[/img]

Each aspect of the city is represented by a variety of cards. Each day, you’ll have the chance to spend your resources to buy more of these.

The most basic cards will improve your city in a variety of ways, but some cards have special features that allow your city to pay off even more of the debt as part of a combo!


[h3]Why have an economy?[/h3]

We really wanted to offer something new and interesting that treats the economy of Farset-13 as more than a simple theme. This isn’t a city management game; we want to give you options that are fast and satisfying. Every time the game resets and you start again at day 1, your city will reset. This means that every time you play, you have the chance to try different strategies for both paying off the debt and changing the world around you. 

We’re all working hard on the game and can’t wait for you to try it! Please join our Discord if you’d like to become a part of our community where you can hear all the latest news about our games.
Tax-Force signing off! 

*distant 90s theme tune*



We’d love to see your comments below, and if you’d like to us more directly, join our community over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/outsidergames]Discord. [/url]
